en.title: Circuit Sand and Memory Droplets
en.premise: In a metropolis run by self‑governing nanomachines, comfort has reached perfection—but at a cost. As convenience erodes feelings and ancient recollections, a young man wanders to the city’s fringe and discovers a strange electronics shop that opens only on rainy days. The shop, a desert oasis of forgotten tech, offers a chance to mend the ‘inconvenient’ memories that the world has let slip away.

zh.title: 回路之砂与记忆之滴
zh.premise: 在全自动纳米机器管理环境的城市里，人们享受着极致的舒适，却因此情感和旧日记忆迅速淡化。主人公少年踏入位于城郊、只在雨天开启的神秘电子部件店。这里宛如沙漠中的绿洲，专为修复被遗忘的‘不便记忆’而存在。
